final: WITH funding AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_box_change, SUM(s.aream2) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM funding) SELECT f.fundflux, f.avg_box_change, f.area_volume_ratio, f.area_volume_ratio - o.avg_ratio FROM funding AS f CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND f.area_volume_ratio > o.avg_ratio
